## 02 · Filter
Port of `judge()` in lectern/collect.py. The rules are `shared/keywords.json` (v0.5.2), never this workflow. Every posting leaves with a decision AND a reason: kept (which rule), or rejected (which test failed). Run it on its own with the Manual trigger (synthetic postings), or let 05 · Daily call it.
